name: OpenForm adaptive aesthetic and orientational continuity
statement: The form preserves recognizable title, section grouping, question order, full field meaning, readable standard typography, keyboard-reachable primary actions, portable light/dark color intent and answer integrity as the browser or future native window changes shape. Rich media sections retain a recognizable accessible alternative if a native renderer lacks an embed mechanism.
changePolicy: Owner-reviewed continuity principle; change with documented evidence

provenance.sourceReference: User request for generic 20-question editor, monochrome themes, adaptive aesthetics and Python transference; docs/EXAMPLES/OPENFORM_CONTINUITY.md; implementation mapping pending owner review

verification.expected: Review light and dark, 320px/intermediate/wide, keyboard, long input, resize, embedded provider fallback and native Python once implemented. No executed test result is claimed.
